questions.q: Solve the simultaneous equations 3x + 2y = 16 and x − 2y = 0.
questions.why: Adding the equations gives 4x = 16, so x = 4 and then 4 − 2y = 0 gives y = 2.

questions.q: Make x the subject of y = (x + a)/(x − 1).
questions.why: xy − y = x + a, so xy − x = a + y, x(y − 1) = a + y.
